feeds.title: Alesong Brewing & Blending Blog
feeds.description: At Alesong, our approach to brewing is patient and artistic. 100% of our beer is matured in barrels and then consciously blended to create a complex and unique beverage experience. We approach brewing like a musician composing a song, like a song, each beer is our expression, but the enjoyment and interpretation are yours

feeds.title: The Beer Chaser
feeds.description: One of my initial retirement goals in 2011 was to eventually have a beer at every neighborhood tavern or brewery in Portland and blog about the experience. One of the other features which have been enjoyable and well received is that I get to meet and continue to meet interesting individuals whose stories deserve to be told and I talk about beer and beer stories in my blog.

feeds.title: Craft Beer Scribe
feeds.description: Craft Beer Scribe is a blog dedicated to exploring and celebrating the craft beer scene in the Pacific Northwest. Founded in 2014, the blog features beer reviews, brewery profiles, and interviews with industry insiders. The mission of Craft Beer Scribe is to share the stories of the people and places behind some of the best beer in the world.

feeds.title: New School Beer + Cider
feeds.description: With more than 10 years of history, The New School has become established as the best place to learn about beer and cider in Oregon and Washington. From new releases to industry and style trends, interviews, commentary and opinion and breaking news and openings, The New School is the place to find it all.

feeds.title: The Brew Site
feeds.description: Active since 2004, The Brew Site is one of the longest-running beer blogs on the web. Dedicated to all things beer and brewing, with a particular focus on Oregon, featuring reviews of beers and breweries, industry news and events, articles on homebrewing, and more.

feeds.title: Beerstone
feeds.description: I'm Aaron Brussat. I'm a beer writer and educator, homebrewer, and brewer at Plank Town Brewing. Beerstone is a Eugene beer blog that focuses on concepts in the craft beer world, local and Oregon beer news, beer travel, and beer education. I introduce good beers to good people, curate beer dinners, promote beer education, and have fun under the guise of work.

feeds.title: Yeast Driven
feeds.description: I've been homebrewing on a regular basis since just after a certain election in 2016. Beyond beer and bread, I like to ferment hot sauces, pickles, kimchi, and even my own miso paste. You can look forward to some posts about those, too. In my blog, you'll find a lot about wines, wine tasting, types of wine and more. So, if you happen to be in the Bend area, please hit me up for a growler fill or two.

feeds.title: Beer Musings PDX
feeds.description: Spouting off about beer in the Pacific Northwest. Beer Musings is a blog that features inspirational designs, illustrations, and graphic elements from the world's best designers. Want more inspiration, browse their blog and find inspirations.

feeds.title: The Not So Professional Beer Blog
feeds.description: The Not So Professional Beer Blog is a blog run by a passionate beer enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. The blog features reviews of beer from around the world, as well as articles on brewing techniques and industry trends. The mission of The Not So Professional Beer Blog is to share a love of beer with the world and inspire others to explore the diverse and exciting world of craft beer.

feeds.title: It's Pub Night
feeds.description: A few years ago I noticed that my friends and I spend a lot of time talking, theorizing, and plotting about beer. Taking inspiration from a friend from Texas, I too started a beer blog and here I write beer reviews, theories and about all the fun that I have here in Portland.

feeds.title: Ninkasi Brewing Company Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2007, Ninkasi Brewing Company is one of the fastest-growing craft breweries in the United States. They're dedicated to brewing the highest quality beverages in support of culture, community, and the uniqueness of each individual and their passions while evoking as much enjoyment as possible along the way.
